reference.note: 3 reasons your business isn't making more money
reference.text: There are three reasons your business is not making as much money as you want. Number one is promotion. You are not putting your product or service in front of enough people, and you are scared to spend money on advertising because you have never tracked what a customer is actually worth to you. Number two is the product or service itself. You built something once and you stopped improving it, so the market moved on without you. Number three is what happens every single day inside your business. You hire soft pansies who complain about the market instead of doing the work, and then you wonder why revenue is flat. Fix those three things in that order and you will make more money.
